title: The wrong order
starting_code:
# This program does things in the wrong order. Find and fix it!
wizard.move_right(2)
wizard.move_right()
door.open()
wizard.pick_up()
wizard.move_right(3)
hints: Read the instructions from top to bottom.
The program tries to open the door before it takes the key.
Move the line that picks up the key before the line that opens the door.
intro: I wrote this program for the next locked door. I made a mistake with the order. Can you fix it?
outro: Thank you for fixing my code, {wizard}.
learned: Now you know that the order of instructions is very important.
